# Anti-Defamation League (ADL)

> The Anti-Defamation League fights antisemitism, hate, and discrimination through litigation, education, research, and community advocacy since 1913.

ADL is a leading civil rights organization dedicated to combating antisemitism and all forms of hate and discrimination. The organization operates through multiple research centers, regional offices across the United States, and international partnerships to address hate crimes, extremism, and bias in education and online spaces.

## Key Topics

- Antisemitism
- Hate crimes
- Extremism
- Civil rights

## About ADL

- [Homepage ORG](https://www.adl.org): ADL homepage featuring Fighting Hate for Good mission and organization overview
- [Who We Are](https://www.adl.org/who-we-are): ADL's mission, values and leadership for anti-hate organization
- [Our Mission and History](https://www.adl.org/about/mission-and-history): ADL founded 1913, mission to stop Jewish defamation and secure fair treatment
- [Regional Offices](https://www.adl.org/about/regional-offices): ADL's 25 regional offices network and local community engagement locations
- [Partnerships](https://www.adl.org/about/partnerships): ADL partnerships with Hillel, Urban League and community organizations

## Research Centers & Initiatives

- [Center on Extremism](https://www.adl.org/research-centers/center-on-extremism): ADL Center on Extremism tracking extremist trends, ideologies and groups
- [Center for Antisemitism Research](https://www.adl.org/research-centers/center-antisemitism-research): ADL Center for Antisemitism Research studying social media and antisemitism
- [Center for Technology & Society](https://www.adl.org/research-centers/center-technology-society): ADL Center for Technology & Society combating online hate and harassment
- [Center to Combat Antisemitism in Education](https://www.adl.org/center-combat-antisemitism-in-education): Ronald Birnbaum Center addressing antisemitism in K-12 schools and universities
- [ADL Ratings & Assessments Institute](https://www.adl.org/adl-ratings-assessments-institute): ADL AI Index, campus antisemitism report cards and policy analysis data

## Fight Antisemitism & Hate

- [Fight Antisemitism](https://www.adl.org/what-we-do/fight-antisemitism): ADL's antisemitism advocacy, monitoring, education and litigation efforts
- [ADL National Litigation](https://www.adl.org/adl-national-litigation): ADL's litigation efforts against antisemitism, extremism and discrimination
- [Report an Incident](https://www.adl.org/report-incident): Incident reporting form for antisemitism, bias, discrimination and hate crimes

## Education & Community Programs

- [Education](https://www.adl.org/about/education): ADL education programs including Awareness to Action and holocaust education
- [International Programs](https://www.adl.org/about/international): ADL's global antisemitism education and advocacy in Europe and Latin America

## Israel Advocacy & Policy

- [ADL and Israel](https://www.adl.org/about/adl-israel): ADL's support for secure, democratic Israel and anti-Israel campaign monitoring
